"""A section-label and heading-boundary approximation.

Recognize completed section names, with larger responses to capitalization,
numbering and heading placement. Recognize conventional patent labels and
Chinese/Japanese labels by dictionary meanings. Estimate heading-ending line
breaks, and a negative offset at the beginning of each document. Only bounded
recent text is retained; split UTF-8 characters and split words are joined.
"""
import codecs
import re
import regex as unicode_re
from functools import lru_cache
import cedict
import jmdict

READS = ()

# Each section family has: ordinary, capitalized, heading-position, ALL-CAPS
# increments. These are activation amplitudes fitted on training text.
LABELS = (
    ('foreword introduction preface',
     (0.76, 1.55, 2.38, 0.5)),
    ('discussion',
     (0.26, 2.03, 1.3, 0.39)),
    ('conclusion conclusions',
     (0.38, 1.48, 0.67, 0.28)),
    ('bibliography references',
     (0.14, 1.34, 0.86, 0.0)),
    ('contents',
     (0.09, 1.56, -0.02, 0.0)),
    ('background overview',
     (0.06, 1.08, 0.9, 1.62)),
    ('abstract',
     (0.0, 0.44, 0.22, 0.43)),
    ('acknowledgement acknowledgements acknowledgment acknowledgments',
     (1.45, 1.57, 0.72, 0.0)),
    ((
        'appendices appendix description findings materials methodology '
        'methods objective objectives procedure procedures purpose '
        'recommendations results significance statement summary '
    ),
     (0.03, 0.56, 0.11, 0.91)),
    ((
        'definition definitions disclaimer general history license '
        'limitations note notes related setup studies study tags views '
    ),
     (0.01, 0.08, 0.0, 0.01)),
)
LABELS = tuple((set(words.split()), weights) for words, weights in LABELS)
ENGLISH = set.union(*(words for words, weights in LABELS))

@lru_cache(maxsize=65536)
def dictionary_label(word):
    gloss = ' '.join(cedict.glosses(word) + jmdict.glosses(word)).lower()
    introductory = any(
        x in gloss for x in ('introduction', 'introductory remarks')
    )
    label = introductory or any(x in gloss for x in (
        'overview', 'summary', 'summarize', 'abstract', 'foreword', 'preface',
        'description', 'explanation', 'table of contents', 'concluding remarks',
        'conclusion', 'background', 'outline'))
    formal = 'foreword' in gloss or 'introductory remarks' in gloss
    return int(label) + int(introductory), formal


def step(carry, prefix, upstream):
    doc = prefix.document_ids[-1]
    if carry is None or carry[0] != doc:
        carry = doc, '', '', 0, b''
    _, line, tail, position, pending = carry
    raw = pending + prefix.token_bytes[-1]
    text, used = codecs.utf_8_decode(raw, 'replace', False)
    pending = raw[used:]
    # Also handle headings inside serialized file contents.
    text = text.replace('\\n', '\n')
    s = text.strip()
    value = -0.001
    if position == 0:
        value -= 0.35
        value += 0.3 * ('<|' in text)
        value += -0.16 * (bool(s) and s[0].isupper())
        value += -2.19 * (text == '<|endoftext|>')

    joined, full = tail + text, line + text
    match = re.search(r'([^\W\d_]+)\Z', joined) if text else None
    word = match[1] if match else ''
    w = word.lower()
    before = full[:-len(word)] if word else line
    heading = len(before.strip(' #*\t0123456789.IVXivx-')) < 2
    numbered = bool(re.search(
        r'(?:[IVXivx]+|\d+(?:\.\d+)*)(?:[.)])?\s*$', before
    ))
    for words, (base, capital, start, upper) in LABELS:
        if w in words and any(ch.isalpha() for ch in text):
            value += base + capital * word[0].isupper() + start * heading
            value += upper * (len(word) > 2 and word.isupper())
            value += 0.33 * numbered
            value += 0.12 * (not text[:1].isspace() and heading)

    if unicode_re.search(
        r'\p{Script=Han}|\p{Script=Hiragana}|\p{Script=Katakana}', text
    ):
        meanings = [dictionary_label(joined[-n:]) for n in (2, 3, 4)]
        kind = max(k for k, formal in meanings)
        value += 0.02 * (kind > 0) + 0.55 * (kind == 2)
        value += 3.78 * any(formal for k, formal in meanings)
        if kind and len(line) < 35 and not re.search('[。！？]', line):
            value += 0.29

    if '\n' in text:
        value += 0.03 * (text in ('\n\n', '\n\n\n'))
        ended = (line + text.split('\n')[0]).strip()
        words = re.findall('[A-Za-z]+', ended)
        clean = re.sub(
            r'^(?:[IVXivx]+|[0-9]+)[.)]\s*', '', ended.strip(' #*\t')
        )
        title = bool(words and clean) and len(ended) < 180 and len(words) <= 18
        title = title and not re.search(r'[.!?;{}=<>]', clean)
        titled = title and clean[0].isupper()
        label = title and any(word.lower() in ENGLISH for word in words)
        prior = tail[:-len(line)] if line else tail
        blank = bool(re.search(r'\n[ \t]*\n[ \t]*$', prior))
        if titled:
            value += 0.1 * (len(words) <= 5)
            value += 0.11 * blank
            value += 0.36 * (position < 25 and '\n' not in prior)
        value += 0.17 * label + 0.55 * (label and blank)
        if (line.lstrip().startswith('#') and words
                and not line.lstrip().startswith('#include')):
            value += 0.06
        if position < 5 and any(
            ended.endswith('<|im_start|>' + role)
            for role in ('user', 'assistant', 'system')
        ):
            value += 0.2
        if re.fullmatch(r'[-=]{3,}', ended):
            previous = prior.strip().split('\n')[-1] if prior.strip() else ''
            if any(word.lower() in ENGLISH
                   for word in re.findall('[A-Za-z]+', previous)):
                value += 0.97
        if len(ended) < 45 and any(
            dictionary_label(ended[-n:])[0] for n in (2, 3, 4)
        ):
            value += 0.52
        line = full.rsplit('\n', 1)[-1]
    else:
        line = full[-256:]

    # Conventional multiword labels, notably patent and academic headings.
    lower = full.lower()
    value += -0.02 * (s == ':')
    if w == 'art' and re.search(
        r'description of (?:the )?(?:related|prior|background) art$', lower
    ):
        value += 1.8
    if w == 'description' and re.search(r'(brief|detailed) description$', lower):
        value += 1.03
    value += 0.5 * (w == 'field' and heading)
    value += 4.18 * (w in ('draw', 'drawings') and 'description of' in lower)
    if w in ('of', 'the') and len(full) < 90 and re.search(
        r'(?:background|description|field|summary) of', lower
    ):
        value += 0.77
    if w == 'invention' and re.search(
        r'(?:field|background) of (?:the )?invention$', lower
    ):
        value += 1.27
    if w in ('related', 'prior', 'background') and 'description of' in lower:
        value += 0.24
    return (doc, line, joined[-160:], position + 1, pending), float(value)

"""Section titles.

The component reads a document's section headings. It is positive inside a short
title-cased or ALL-CAPS line (at most 8 words, small words such as "of", "the", "and"
allowed) that contains a standard section word: Introduction, Discussion, Description,
Drawings, Summary, Conclusion, References, Background, and similar. It is strongest on the
section word itself (e.g. "Introduction", "DRAW" of DRAWINGS, "INGS"), weaker on the other
words of the title, and it is also positive on the line break that closes such a title.
Everywhere else it is near zero, except that the first token of a document (the start of a
row or the token after <|endoftext|>) is typically negative.

The values are rough averages from training text, scaled down because they overshoot.
The program does not model the diffuse, token-by-token variation of ordinary prose, which
is most of the remaining variance and is not explained by any concept here.
"""

READS = ()

# standard section words; the value is the typical activation on that word
SECTION_VALUE = {
    "draw": 4.5, "drawings": 4.4, "introduction": 3.5, "discussion": 3.8,
    "description": 3.3, "background": 3.0, "conclusion": 2.9, "conclusions": 2.8,
    "references": 2.4, "summary": 2.2, "overview": 2.0,
}
# other section words, which mark a title without a strong value of their own
OTHER_SECTION_WORDS = {
    "acknowledgment", "acknowledgement", "acknowledgments", "abstract", "objectives",
    "objective", "methods", "method", "invention", "appendix", "notes", "history",
    "outlook", "aims", "review", "motivation", "contents", "results", "statement",
    "purpose", "changelog", "log", "author", "problem", "takeaways", "about",
}
SMALL_WORDS = {"of", "the", "and", "a", "an", "in", "to", "for", "on", "with", "or", "from", "by", "at"}

DOC_START = -0.38       # first token of a document or row
TITLE_VALUE = 0.5       # a title word without a value of its own
BREAK_VALUE = 0.5       # the line break that closes a title
SCALE = 0.75            # all values are shrunk toward zero: the averages overshoot


def words_of(line):
    """The words of a line, without surrounding punctuation."""
    return [w.strip(".,:;()\"'*#&-") for w in line.split()]


def is_title(line):
    """A short Title Case or ALL CAPS line that contains a section word."""
    words = [w for w in words_of(line) if w]
    if not words or len(words) > 8:
        return False
    known = set(SECTION_VALUE) | OTHER_SECTION_WORDS
    if not any(w.lower() in known for w in words):
        return False
    return all(w[0].isupper() or w.lower() in SMALL_WORDS for w in words if w[0].isalpha())


def step(carry, prefix, upstream):
    if prefix.position == 0 or prefix.document_ids[-1] != prefix.document_ids[-2]:
        return carry, DOC_START
    text = prefix.text_prefixes[-1]
    token = prefix.token_strings[-1]
    if "\n" in token:
        # a line break: positive if it closes a title
        title = is_title(text.rstrip("\n").split("\n")[-1])
        return carry, BREAK_VALUE * float(title)
    line = text.split("\n")[-1]
    if not is_title(line):
        return carry, 0.0
    word = words_of(line)[-1].lower() if words_of(line) else ""
    value = SECTION_VALUE.get(word, TITLE_VALUE)
    return carry, SCALE * value

"""Approximate orthographic selectivity around n/N.

Short n-ending fragments use their left consonants, case and token boundaries.
Lowercase y+n is positive; many consonant+N initialisms are negative. Merged
fragments use separate, generally smaller amplitudes. Romanian nasal spellings
and Greek upsilon+nu have additional positive rules. Repeated middle dots and
some document-opening formats have small explicit side rules.

Track a 400-character, width-normalised suffix, resetting on document changes
and end-of-text markers. Numbers approximate training amplitudes; there are no
token-ID or whole-word activation tables. Unmodelled contexts default to zero.
"""
import re
import unicodedata

READS = ()

# Left-hand letters: separate n, and n merged into a short fragment.
LOWER = (
    ('bp', -2.0, -1.4),
    ('f', -0.7, -0.3),
    ('v', -3.2, -0.1),
    ('s', -0.4, -0.2),
    ('t', -0.7, -0.2),
    ('ck', -0.6, -0.3),
    ('qx', -2.6, -1.1),
    ('r', -0.5, -0.2),
    ('l', -0.8, 0.0),
    ('y', 2.0, 0.7),
    ('mn', 0.1, 0.1),
    ('d', 0.0, -0.3),
)
UPPER = (
    ('BFP', -4.1, -1.4),
    ('DT', -4.1, -1.5),
    ('CKX', -3.5, 0.2),
    ('Q', -5.8, -1.1),
    ('LR', -3.7, -0.2),
    ('MN', 0.1, -0.4),
    ('S', -7.6, -0.8),
    ('V', -5.8, 0.0),
    ('GHJWYZ', -0.8, 0.6),
)
CONSONANTS = 'bcdfgklmpqrstvwxz'
ROMANIAN_WORDS = re.compile(
    r'\b(?:pentru|sunt|fost|acest|aceasta)\b', re.I
)
ROMANIAN_ENDINGS = re.compile(r'\b\w+(?:ului|elor|ilor)\b', re.I)
ROMANIAN_CLUES = re.compile(r'\b(?:si|sa|cu|este|sau|din)\b', re.I)
ROMANIAN_FUNCTION_WORDS = re.compile(
    r'\b(?:si|sa|cu|este|sau|pentru|sunt|fost|din|de|la|pe|a|un)\b', re.I
)


def letter_value(ch, table, fused):
    if not ch:
        return 0.0
    for letters, separate, merged in table:
        if ch in letters:
            return merged if fused else separate
    return 0.0


def response(token, before):
    s = token.strip(' .-_()\\\n\t\r')
    if s.endswith('Ns'):
        s = s[:-1]  # plural initialisms, e.g. IFNs
    fused = len(s) > 1
    attached = token[:1].isalnum() or (
        token.startswith('.') and s.endswith('N') and s.isupper()
    )
    left = (before if attached else '') + s[:-1]
    ch = left[-1:]
    value = 0.0

    if s.endswith('n') and len(s) <= 3:
        # Ordinary vowel-containing syllables are not consonant fragments.
        if not any(c in 'aeiou' for c in s[:-1].lower()):
            value = letter_value(ch.lower(), LOWER, fused)
            if not fused and re.search('[%s]{2}$' % CONSONANTS, left, re.I):
                value -= 0.4
                if ch.lower() in 'fpv':
                    value -= 1.0
            if fused and attached and ch.lower() in CONSONANTS + 'yn':
                prev = before[-1:].lower()
                value += letter_value(prev, (
                    ('bmpfvcqkx', -0.6, -0.6),
                    ('dst', -0.3, -0.3),
                    ('lrn', 0.2, 0.2),
                    ('y', 1.2, 1.2),
                ), False)
            if ch.isupper() and ch != 'Y':
                value *= 0.25
            # Especially strong, unusual three-consonant endings.
            pair = left[-2:]
            if (attached and len(s) <= 2
                    and (pair[:1] in 'bgkmp' and pair[1:] == 't'
                         or pair in ('tf', 'sp'))):
                value = min(value, -4.5)
            if attached and len(s) <= 2 and pair in ('ms', 'mv'):
                value = min(value, -6.0)
        if not before and s == 'n':
            value = -1.0

    elif (s.endswith('N') and s.isupper() and len(s) <= 6
          and ch not in 'AEIOU'):
        value = letter_value(ch, UPPER, fused)
        run = re.search('[A-Z]+$', left)
        length = len(run[0]) if run else 0
        if length >= 2:
            value -= 0.75
        elif not fused:
            value = max(value, -3.0)
        if length >= 4:
            value += 0.9
        if fused and re.search('[BCDFGKLMPQRSTVWXZ]{2}$', left):
            value -= 2.3
        if token.startswith('.'):
            value *= 0.6
        if not before and s == 'N':
            value = -0.7
        if length >= 7 and sum(c in 'AEIOU' for c in run[0]) >= 2:
            value *= 0.2

    # Language-specific positive spellings of the nasal.
    boundary = token[:1].isspace() or not before or not before[-1:].isalpha()
    if (s in ('în', 'În', 'î', 'Î') and boundary
            or len(s) <= 3 and s.endswith('ân')):
        value += 3.0
    if (before[-1:] in ('î', 'Î')
            and (len(before) == 1 or not before[-2].isalpha())
            and token in ('n', 'N', 'nc', 'ns')):
        value = 5.0
    if token in ('ν', 'Ν') and before[-1:] and before[-1:] in 'υύΥΎ':
        value += 1.6
    if boundary and s in ('in', 'In', 'IN', 'intr', 'Intr', 'n', 'N'):
        words = len(ROMANIAN_FUNCTION_WORDS.findall(before))
        romanian = bool(ROMANIAN_WORDS.search(before)) and words >= 2
        romanian |= (len(ROMANIAN_ENDINGS.findall(before)) >= 2
                     and bool(ROMANIAN_CLUES.search(before)))
        romanian |= any(c in before for c in 'șțȘȚ') and words >= 3
        if romanian:
            value += 4.0
    if token == "'n":
        value += 1.3

    # Formatting offsets: repeated dots, initial escapes, title headers.
    if len(token) >= 2 and set(token) == {'·'}:
        value = -1.95
    if not before and token in ('\\n', '\\t', '//\\n', '\r'):
        value = -2.0
    if not before and token == '//\n':
        value = -4.1
    if not before and token == 'N':
        value = -0.7
    if token == ':' and before == 'Title':
        value = -4.0
    return value


def step(carry, prefix, upstream):
    doc = prefix.document_ids[-1]
    before = '' if carry is None or carry[0] != doc else carry[1]
    token = unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', prefix.token_strings[-1])
    if token == '<|endoftext|>':
        return (doc, ''), 0.0
    value = response(token, before)
    return (doc, (before + token)[-400:]), float(value)

"""Layer-1 MLP down-projection component 4214: an "acronym-final N" detector.

The component is silent almost everywhere. Its large responses come from the
letter N (or n) when it is glued onto the letters before it inside one word,
so that it completes an abbreviation or a non-word fragment:

  * A bare capital N right after a two-letter capitals fragment is strongly
    negative: "IF|N" (interferon), "SS|N", "AV|N", "IUC|N", "FR|N". One- or
    three-letter fragments are weaker, longer ones barely fire.
  * A bare lowercase n right after a two-letter consonant-only fragment is
    mildly negative: "df|n", "mv|n", "rx|n", "cr|n".
  * A whole token of capitals ending in a consonant plus N is negative:
    " ISBN", " ESPN", "BN", "DN", "TN".
  * The Romanian preposition " în" / " î" is strongly positive, and the
    whole pieces "yn" and "lyn" are mildly positive.

Everything else predicts 0. Only the previous token and the current one are
read, and nothing carries over a document boundary.
"""

READS = ()

VOWELS = "aeiouyAEIOUY"

N_AFTER_CAPS2 = -4.6     # N after a two-letter capitals fragment
N_AFTER_CAPS13 = -1.8    # N after a one- or three-letter capitals fragment
N_AFTER_CAPS_LONG = -0.7  # N after a longer capitals fragment
N_LOWER_AFTER_CONS2 = -1.8  # n after a two-letter consonant-only fragment
ACRONYM_SPACED = -1.7    # " ISBN"-like capitals ending in consonant+N, with a space
ACRONYM_GLUED = -1.0     # the same, glued to the previous piece
ROMANIAN_IN = 3.7        # " în" / " î"
YN_PIECES = 1.0          # "yn", "lyn"


def _letters(s):
    return s.isalpha()


def _acronym_ending(word):
    """Capitals of length 2 to 6 ending in N, with a consonant before the N."""
    return (
        _letters(word)
        and word.isupper()
        and 2 <= len(word) <= 6
        and word[-1] == "N"
        and word[-2] not in VOWELS
    )


def step(carry, prefix, upstream):
    cur = prefix.token_strings[-1]
    word = cur.strip()
    spaced = cur.startswith(" ")
    same_doc = len(prefix) > 1 and prefix.document_ids[-2] == prefix.document_ids[-1]
    prev = prefix.token_strings[-2].strip() if same_doc else ""
    value = 0.0

    if word == "N" and not spaced and prev.isalpha() and prev.isupper():
        if len(prev) == 2:
            value = N_AFTER_CAPS2
        elif len(prev) in (1, 3):
            value = N_AFTER_CAPS13
        else:
            value = N_AFTER_CAPS_LONG
    elif word == "n" and not spaced and same_doc and len(prev) == 2 and prev.isalpha():
        if not any(c in VOWELS for c in prev):
            value = N_LOWER_AFTER_CONS2
    elif _acronym_ending(word):
        value = ACRONYM_SPACED if spaced else ACRONYM_GLUED
    elif spaced and word in ("în", "î"):
        value = ROMANIAN_IN
    elif not spaced and word in ("yn", "lyn"):
        value = YN_PIECES
    return carry, float(value)

"""layers.1.mlp.down_proj:4215, a "language code in a locale tag or URL" detector.

What it does: this component goes clearly negative on a two-letter language or country
code (en, zh, fr, it, de, ...) when the code is used as an identifier: inside a locale
list ('en-US', 'zh-TW'), a URL host or path ('https://en.wikipedia', 'src/it/'), or after
a colon or a quote ('setlang('en')', 'iso 3166-1: fr'). It also goes negative on the
region or script suffix that follows such a code ('-CN', '-Hans').
Ordinary English words, French elisions (l'ur) and ordinary text stay near zero.

On <|endoftext|>, the document separator, it sits at about -1.9. That position is
never scored for next-token effects, but it carries much of the variance.

The program predicts -4 on a code in such a position, -4 on a locale suffix after a code,
-1.9 on <|endoftext|>, and 0 elsewhere.
"""

READS = ()

# Two-letter language codes that appear as identifiers (ISO 639-1 style).
LANG_CODES = set(
    """ar bg bn ca cs cy de en es et eu fa fi fr ga he hi hr hu hy ja ka kk ko lt lv mk mt
    nl pl pt ro ru sq sr sv sw uk ur uz vi zh""".split()
)
# Characters that open an identifier: a URL slash, a colon, or a double quote.
OPENERS = set("/:\"")
# Brackets or commas before a quoted code, as in ['en-US', 'zh'].
LIST_OPENERS = set("[(, ")

EOS_VALUE = -1.9
CODE_VALUE = -4.0


def step(carry, prefix, upstream):
    tokens = prefix.token_strings
    tok = tokens[-1]
    prev = tokens[-2] if len(tokens) > 1 else ""
    before = tokens[-3] if len(tokens) > 2 else ""
    if tok == "<|endoftext|>":
        return carry, EOS_VALUE
    if tok in LANG_CODES and prev[-1:] in OPENERS:
        return carry, CODE_VALUE
    if tok in LANG_CODES and prev == "'" and before[-1:] in LIST_OPENERS:
        return carry, CODE_VALUE
    if prev in LANG_CODES and tok[:1] == "-" and tok[1:2].isupper():
        return carry, CODE_VALUE
    return carry, 0.0

"""A contextual approximation to a classical-Chinese writing signal.

Estimate negative contributions on single-Han tokens, especially classical
function characters following other single-Han tokens. Recent character and
particle runs adjust this estimate. Handle Arabic vowel marks, unaccented
breathed Greek epsilon, URL separators, document headers and chat markup
separately.
This intentionally leaves ordinary word-specific fluctuations unexplained.
"""
from functools import lru_cache
import regex

READS = ()
GENITIVE = set('之其')

"""A short-memory detector of instructions and references to their inputs.

It emphasizes 'the following', 'solve each', question alternatives, and
requests for an opinion. Capitalized verbs and 'please' strengthen the
instruction cue. A few explicit document/observation labels are separate cues.
This approximates the component's larger responses, not its small fluctuations.

import re

READS = ()
TASK_VERBS = set('''write read solve compute calculate evaluate express simplify
translate rewrite convert round sort define represent identify determine
complete fill choose select classify explain describe compare prove interpret
summarize analyse analyze list name draw graph label match underline tick
rate fix continue answer respond supply'''.split())
GENERAL_VERBS = set('''use make show find change give provide create place put
check highlight indicate consider state tell insert replace print return'''.split())
OBJECTS = set('''text word words sentence sentences paragraph story answer
answers response reasoning opinion explanation reasons option options choice
choices alternatives question questions problem problems task tasks statement
statements blank blanks table diagram boxes brackets'''.split())
SPECIFIERS = {'given', 'provided', 'indicated', 'specified', 'remaining', 'nearest'}
# (Effect of an immediately preceding instruction, effect of an earlier one.)
INSTRUCTION_EFFECT = {
    'article': (0.57, 0.32),
    'pointing': (2.25, 0.71),
    'following': (0.0, 2.07),
    'input': (0.61, 1.32),
    'object': (0.05, 0.37),
    'link': (0.09, 0.17),
}


def step(carry, prefix, upstream):
    document = prefix.document_ids[-1]
    text = carry[1] if carry is not None and carry[0] == document else ''
    token = prefix.token_strings[-1]
    whole = text + token
    # Join split words, but do not treat punctuation as repeating the last word.
    match = re.search(r'[A-Za-z]+$', whole)
    word = match[0].lower() if match and re.search('[A-Za-z]', token) else ''
    left = whole[:match.start()] if word else text
    raw = re.findall(r'[A-Za-z]+', left)[-8:]
    past = [w.lower() for w in raw]
    prev = past[-1] if past else ''
    value = 0.0
    if word == 'each':
        value -= 0.14
    if word in {'this', 'these'}:
        value += 0.04
    if word == 'following' and prev == 'the':
        value += 0.54
    if word in SPECIFIERS and prev == 'the':
        value += 0.82
    if word == 'below':
        value += 0.16
    if word in OBJECTS:
        value += 0.06
        if prev in {'following', 'each', 'your', 'correct', 'appropriate'}:
            value += 0.61
    if word in {'write', 'translate', 'respond'}:
        value += 0.31

    immediate = recent = 0.0
    for distance, w in enumerate(reversed(past), 1):
        if w not in TASK_VERBS and w not in GENERAL_VERBS:
            continue
        polite = distance < len(past) and past[-distance-1] == 'please'
        strong = raw[-distance][:1].isupper() or polite
        strength = 1.0 if strong else 0.25 if w in TASK_VERBS else 0.08
        if distance == 1:
            immediate = strength
        else:
            recent = max(recent, strength * 0.7 ** (distance-2))
    kind = ('article' if word == 'the' else
            'pointing' if word in {'this', 'these', 'each'} else
            'following' if word == 'following' else
            'input' if word in SPECIFIERS or word == 'below' else
            'object' if word in OBJECTS else
            'link' if word in {'of', 'to', 'in', 'as', 'or', 'if', 'from'} else '')
    a, b = INSTRUCTION_EFFECT.get(kind, (0, 0))
    value += a * immediate + b * recent

    questioning = any(w in {'which', 'what', 'how', 'whether'} for w in past[-6:])
    if word == 'following' and questioning:
        value += 1.28
    if word in {'this', 'these'} and prev in {'does', 'do', 'is', 'are', 'was'}:
        value += 0.54
    if word == 'of' and (prev == 'which' or prev == 'one' and questioning):
        value += 1.23
    if (word == 'on' and prev == 'based' or
            word == 'the' and past[-2:] == ['based', 'on']):
        value += 0.29
    if word in {'think', 'agree', 'expect'} and prev == 'you':
        value += 0.56
        if any(w in {'do', 'did', 'don'} for w in past[-3:]):
            value += 1.54
    if word == 'or' and prev in {'whether', 'true', 'yes', 'prove'}:
        value += 0.88
    if word in {'true', 'false', 'yes', 'no'} and prev in {'or', 'if'}:
        value += 0.53
    if word == 'if' and prev in {'again', 'tell', 'determine', 'check'}:
        value += 0.41
    if word == 'below' and prev in {'diagram', 'table', 'box', 'answer', 'question', 'given'}:
        value += 2.05

    if token.startswith(':') and text.endswith('OBSERVATION'):
        value += 0.47
    if token == ':' and text.endswith('Title'):
        value += 5.36 if text == 'Title' else 0.99
    if token.strip() in {'以下', 'suiv', 'folgenden', 'siguiente', 'siguientes'}:
        value += 0.68
    if len(token) >= 2 and not token.strip('·'):
        value -= 0.70
    if not text:
        value -= 0.13
        if token.startswith('<|'):
            value -= 0.17
    return (document, whole[-180:]), float(value)

"""Estimate a capitalization boundary without normal sentence punctuation.

A capitalized fragment after a lowercase content word gives a negative pulse.
The definite article and other plausible sentence openers are strongest; ordinary
name-like fragments are weaker. Punctuation and preceding function words mostly
suppress the pulse. English frequency and dictionary word classes set its size.

import re
from functools import lru_cache
from wordfreq import zipf_frequency
import wordnet

OPENERS = frozenset('this that these those he she it they we you i a an there here'.split())

@lru_cache(maxsize=50000)
def word_properties(word):
    word = word.lower()
    pos = wordnet.parts_of_speech(word) if word.isascii() else ()
    return (zipf_frequency(word, 'en'), 'noun' in pos,
            'verb' in pos, 'adjective' in pos)


def boundary_value(token, before):
    text = token.lstrip()
    if not text or not text[0].isupper():
        return 0.0
    match = re.search(r'([^\W\d_]+)[ \t]*$', before)
    previous = match[1] if match else ''
    end = before[-1:] if before else ''
    if not previous:
        return -0.12 if end.isdigit() else 0.0

    frequency, noun, verb, adjective = word_properties(previous)
    current_frequency, _, current_verb, _ = word_properties(text)
    if text.lower() == 'the':
        if not previous.islower():
            return -0.15
        if len(previous) <= 2:
            return -0.35
        return -2.3 if noun else -1.2

    if len(previous) <= 3:
        return -0.02
    if not noun:
        return -0.20 if end.isspace() else -0.02
    if not previous.islower():
        return -0.06
    if not token.startswith((' ', '\t')):
        return -0.08

    if current_verb:
        return -1.3 if frequency <= 5.1 and not adjective else -0.33
    letters = sum(c.isalpha() for c in text)
    if current_frequency >= 6.0 and letters > 1:
        return -1.8 if text.lower() in OPENERS else -0.85
    if frequency <= 4.7 and letters > 3:
        return -0.98 if current_frequency >= 5.0 else -0.33
    return -0.13

    document = prefix.document_ids[-1]
    before = carry[1] if carry is not None and carry[0] == document else ''
    token = prefix.token_strings[-1]
    value = boundary_value(token, before)
    return (document, (before + token)[-150:]), value
